title: Corebridge Financial announces first quarter 2026 results
summary: Corebridge Financial, Inc. (NYSE: CRBG) today reported financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026.
body_markdown:
Corebridge Financial, Inc. (NYSE: CRBG) reported financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026.


“Corebridge delivered strong financial results in the first quarter,” said Marc Costantini, President and Chief Executive Officer. “Earnings per share and return on equity both improved year over year. This, alongside consistent organic growth and the proceeds from our variable annuity transaction, supported a record return of capital to shareholders through repurchases.”


Visit our[Investor Relations website](https://investors.corebridgefinancial.com/overview/default.aspx) for Corebridge earnings materials.
